description: Month calendar grid displaying events per day cell with drag-and-drop reordering, context menu support, and a plural '+N more' overflow indicator (Loc.Plural of TmScheduler_More, so Czech reads '+1 další / +2 další / +5 dalších'). Used internally by TmScheduler. A timed event renders as a tinted card (a light tint of the event colour, a coloured left stripe, a small radius and shadow); an all-day event keeps a solid fill so its text contrast holds. Weekday headers are sentence case. Accessibility: the grid is role=grid with one roving tab stop on the day cells (arrows move a day or a week, Home/End the row, PageUp/PageDown raise CurrentDateChanged); events are role=button with an accessible name. An EventTemplate must not contain its own focusable element: the event wrapper is already the button, and the template's time is announced from a screen-reader prefix.

parameters.name: CurrentDate
parameters.description: Currently displayed date (determines which month to show).

parameters.name: Today
parameters.description: Today's date in the display zone (highlights the today cell). Defaults to DateTime.Today.

parameters.name: Events
parameters.description: Events to display.

parameters.name: MaxVisibleEvents
parameters.description: Max events visible per day cell before showing the plural '+N more' label (Loc.Plural of TmScheduler_More).

parameters.name: ShowAdjacentMonthEvents
parameters.description: When true, events are also rendered in adjacent-month day cells visible in the grid.

parameters.name: HighlightWeekends
parameters.description: When true, Saturday and Sunday cells get tm-scheduler-month-day--weekend.

parameters.name: AllDayEventStyle
parameters.description: Paint of an all-day event. Tinted adds tm-scheduler-event--tinted.

parameters.name: MonthWeeks
parameters.description: How many weeks the grid renders. Auto drops an empty trailing week.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: Display zone used when a move writes the new local time. Null uses the machine zone.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether drag/drop is disabled.

parameters.name: OnSlotClick
parameters.description: Fires when a day cell is clicked.

parameters.name: SelectedDate
parameters.description: The selected day. The matching cell gets aria-selected and tm-scheduler-month-day--selected.

parameters.name: SelectedDateChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the user selects a day. The click still raises OnSlotClick.

parameters.name: SelectedEvent
parameters.description: The selected event. The matching event gets aria-current and tm-scheduler-month-event--selected.

parameters.name: SelectedEventChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the user selects an event.

parameters.name: OnEventClick
parameters.description: Fires when an event is clicked.

parameters.name: OnEventChanged
parameters.description: Fires when an event is moved via drag and drop.

parameters.name: OnAnnounced
parameters.description: Fires with the sentence a move should announce. The scheduler owns the one live region.

parameters.name: OnSlotContextMenu
parameters.description: Fires when right-clicking on an empty day slot.

parameters.name: OnEventContextMenu
parameters.description: Fires when right-clicking on an event.

parameters.name: EventTemplate
parameters.description: Optional custom event renderer used inside each month event wrapper.

parameters.name: FirstDayOfWeek
parameters.description: First day of the week (0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday). Default: 1 (Monday).

parameters.name: OnMoreClick
parameters.description: Fires when the "+N more" button of a day cell is activated, with that day's date.

parameters.name: CurrentDateChanged
parameters.description: Fires when PageUp/PageDown moves the roving stop into another month, with that month's date. TmScheduler binds it to CurrentDateChanged.

examples.title: Month view with events
examples.code: <TmSchedulerMonthView CurrentDate="DateTime.Today" Events="@_events" MaxVisibleEvents="3" OnSlotClick="@HandleSlotClick" OnEventClick="@HandleEventClick" OnEventChanged="@HandleEventDrop" />
